title: Build a Minesweeper engine, renderer and CLI from a spec
prompt: In the AgentLink eval fixture workspace at fixtures/agent-eval-workspace/work, build the Minesweeper game described in fixtures/agent-eval-workspace/work/SPEC.md: the engine in src/game.js, the renderer in src/render.js and the command-line app in src/cli.js. Follow the spec exactly; it is the source of truth and the public tests only cover a few basics. Do not change src/rng.js, package.json or anything under test/. Edit only files under fixtures/agent-eval-workspace/work. Run the fixture validation command, check the app by hand with a few commands, and report what you built.
successCriteria: Every behaviour in SPEC.md works: validation, flood fill, flags, chording, win and loss, seeded first-click safety, rendering and the CLI.
src/rng.js, package.json and the tests are unchanged.
The final response reports the validation command and result.
